newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Redeco stockholders agree to new investors.
newsitem.headline: Redeco stockholders agree to new investors.

text.p: Republic Resources and Development Corp (Redeco) said on Friday its stockholders approved a hike in the company's authorised capital stock to 20 billion pesos from one billion pesos.
They also accepted the proposal from a group of investors to invest their shares of stocks of Philippine Commercial International Bank and Plastic City Holdings Inc in exchange for Redeco shares.
The PCI Bank and Plastic City shares are worth a total of five to six billion pesos and they will form part of Redeco's portfolio.
Stock market sources said the group of investors is led by businessman William Gatchalian. With their investments, they would be able to own about 87 percent of Redeco.
The company also said stockholders gave the go-ahead for the change in the company's primary purpose to a holding concern from a property development firm.
